name: Fresh Canna Live Resin | Northern Lights
description: Drift into deep relaxation with Fresh Canna’s Live Resin Wax – Northern Lights, a classic indica powerhouse renowned for its tranquilizing effects and rich, earthy flavor. Crafted from fresh-frozen cannabis, this live resin wax preserves the full terpene and cannabinoid profile, delivering a smooth and potent experience with every dab. With sweet pine, spicy earth, and a hint of citrus, Northern Lights provides a soothing body high that melts away stress and tension. Perfect for unwinding after a long day, easing pain, or getting a restful night’s sleep, this strain is a must-have for indica lovers seeking ultimate relaxation.
